facts.fact: The N'Djamena town hall cites the volume of archives, the still heavy recourse to physical procedures and the risk of loss or deterioration of documents in its civil-status service at the launch of the digitisation project.
facts.system: État civil de la commune de N'Djamena

facts.fact: The commune of N'Djamena launched a project on 23 September 2026 to digitise its civil status and signed a memorandum with ANATS; an integrated management platform, digital solutions and interconnection of systems are planned, none reported in service.
facts.system: État civil de la commune de N'Djamena

facts.fact: The project is the commune of N'Djamena's, under a memorandum with the state agency ANATS, supported by the OIF.
facts.system: État civil de la commune de N'Djamena
